svg.title: One adder, six switches, eighteen operations
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One adder, six switches, eighteen operations” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch of the Hack ALU: two sixteen-wire buses x and y pass through four amber control switches zx, nx, zy and ny into a single block that computes both x plus y and x and y, a multiplexer selects between them under control bit f, an output switch no can invert the result, and two status wires zr and ng peel off the output bus; beneath it a control table with six of the eighteen documented bit patterns and the subtraction row highlighted, a worked trace of three minus five, and a rejected design of eighteen separate circuits crossed out in red.
svg.text: One adder, six switches, eighteen operations
draw it from memory, then compare
